theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_hasDerivAt_of_weighted_jacobian
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (a : RectifiablePair n ℓ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (m : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (J J' : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (δ B : ℝ), 0 < δ → IsCompact K → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ, m t = ∫⁻ x in a.M ∩ K, ENNReal.ofReal (a.θ x * J t x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ, AEStronglyMeasurable (J t) ((μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)).restrict a.M)) → AEStronglyMeasurable g ((μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)).restrict a.M) → (∀ x ∉ K, g x = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)).restrict a.M, x ∈ K → J' 0 x = g x ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ, 0 ≤ J t x ∧ J t x ≤ B ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ J s x) (J' t x) t ∧ |J' t x| ≤ B) → HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ (m t).toReal) (∫ x, g x ∂(mk a).weight) 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
